passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Enacted text of the single-subject ESA bill: new section 15-2401.01 makes every student eligible to enroll in an Arizona public school a qualified student.

rows.reasoning: Payne co-sponsored and voted Y on HB2853 (2022), a single-subject Arizona empowerment scholarship account bill whose new section 15-2401.01 makes "qualified student" include every resident "eligible to enroll in a public school in this state" in preschool-disabilities, kindergarten or grades one through twelve, with the state transferring ninety percent of the student's base support level into the account. That enacts universal eligibility rather than eligibility for "most families", and the account pays tuition at a "nongovernmental primary or secondary school" as well as "Services provided by a public school", matching the rung text "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family". The act dates from his House service in the same legislature, so it is coded as in-term under V5.
